scope: Evidence review for Super Witch and its required Big Boy spawned subunit before behavior is enabled.

sources.title: New In Town Hall 16!
sources.finding: Supercell publishes Super Witch level 7 as 3,600 HP and 420 DPS.

sources.title: January Balance Changes!
sources.finding: Supercell increases Super Witch level-7 HP by 4.17% and DPS by 2.38%, and changes Big Boy housing space from 10 to 20.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
sources.finding: Supercell identifies Witch and Super Witch level 8 as TH18 content, but publishes no Big Boy stat or spawning contract.

sources.title: Super Witch/Big Boy | Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.finding: The consulted secondary page identifies Big Boy as the Super Witch subunit, but does not establish a version-pinned TH18 stat table or deterministic summon lifecycle.

established: Super Witch level 8 is permanent TH18 content and Big Boy is its required spawned subunit.
Big Boy housing space is 20 after the January 2026 balance change.
Big Boy is absent from the frozen normalized catalogue, so it cannot be materialized through immutable GameData without inventing values.
unresolved: No located primary source gives Big Boy hitpoints, damage, attack cadence, speed, range, footprint, target priority, Wall behavior, level mapping or a public asset.

No source defines initial summon delay, whether exactly one Big Boy may coexist, respawn delay, spawn position, target selection, death ordering, Spring Trap behavior, or snapshot-relevant lifecycle state.
The precise level-8 Super Witch HP/DPS values are kept in the pinned secondary catalogue; the official TH18 note identifies the level but does not publish those numbers.
decision: Do not enable super_witch or big_boy in Core, GUI or RL until a version-identified Big Boy stat table and deterministic summon lifecycle contract are available. Do not substitute Golemite, Giant Skeleton, skeleton trap units or a generic periodic spawner.
